text:
Ellen (PM): Quick qtr OKR lane sweep — short async check. TL;DR: what shipped, what slipped, owners & immediate dep actions. Pls reply with one-line status + any CR/ops pings.

Ellen (PM): Shipped: model-routing canary (60% traffic), docs + SDK example.
Ellen (PM): Slipped: embeddings cache v2 (needs batching changes) -> moved to next sprint.
Ellen (PM): Risk: dedicated autoscale saw higher p99 in canary, Jordan please confirm rollback window.

Alex (Eng): model-routing canary is green for endpoint paths /generate and /chat. Perf ok except long-context (8k+) — seeing +30ms p95. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runner/pull/4321 needs final review from @Priya.

Priya (Platform Eng): looking now. autoscale perf regression linked to CUDA driver mismatch on the node pool. Opening infra ticket. PR #4321 — will review, but need to add a small config tweak: `max_batch_delay_ms: 8` before merge.

Jordan (SRE): We have a 2h rollback window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT if needed. If autoscale regresses again at >10% error budget consumption, we flip to canary-0 fallback. I’ll post the runbook in #eng-oncall.

Marta (PM): Embeddings cache v2 slip: blockers are batching behavior + quality regression on long tail. Owner: Alex, can you propose a minimal mitigation so we don't block downstream search team?

Alex (Eng): For embeddings cache v2 I can cut a fallback: opt-out flag `embed_cache=v1` and docs to opt in. That removes immediate blocking surface for search. Will open PR later today (ETA EOD).

Priya (Platform Eng): Infra ticket created: INF-2145. ETA to fix node pool driver: 1 business day after approval. I’ll attach node pool rollout checklist.

Ellen (PM): Action items I'm tracking: 1) Alex open fallback PR for embeddings (EOD). 2) Priya finalize driver rollout (tomorrow). 3) Jordan confirm rollback readiness (tomorrow within window). 4) @All — call out any other dependent teams (search, billing) who need heads-up.

Alex (Eng): PR for embeddings fallback opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/8592 — needs review from @Marta @Priya. Small change, tests added.

Marta (PM): I’ll review PR #8592 this afternoon. Notifying Search: @search-team — heads-up that v2 cache is delayed but fallback prevents consumer impact.

Jordan (SRE): Posting runbook snippet here for quick reference:
```
# rollback steps
1. Route canary -> baseline via router API
2. Disable autoscale rule id: autoscale-q2-3
3. Monitor p50/p95/p99 for 15m
4. If stable, flip traffic back gradually
```

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: model-routing v1.7.2 -> us-west-2 (60%): SUCCESS (2026-03-20T16:12:30Z)

Priya (Platform Eng): FYI tagging infra-owners: @infra-team. Will follow up with rollout approval request in the morning.

Ellen (PM): Thanks team. If no objections, I’ll mark milestone as "partial ship" in the OKR tracker (model-routing partial, embeddings slip). Any last blockers?

Alex (Eng): none from eng side — will update PR links in tracker.

Marta (PM): none. I’ll send short note to GTM for messaging.

Priya (Platform Eng): none. Will ping here once node pool rollout is scheduled.

Jordan (SRE): All set from SRE side for rollback window.

Ellen (PM): Great — closing this async check. If you replied with an action, please add a quick ✅ reaction when it's complete so I can sweep. :white_check_mark:
